referenceFunction.generalComment: Multi-output process providing the products "round wood, primary forest, clear-cutting, at forest road" and "provision, stubbed land". Emissions from wood burning and land transformation are allocated to the provision of stubbed land. The round wood dataset must not be used as a basis for comparison with tropical wood from sustainable forest management. The environmental impacts of tropical wood from clear-cutting must be evaluated in combination with the environmental impacts related to the provision of stubbed land.; UUID: b23a6bb4-8174-3d92-aa5d-629135f9a778
